title: Repository policy for GitHub workflows and composite actions
description: Static gate `workflow-policy` (scripts/ci/pipeline.py): the AGENTS.md workflow rules that the GitHub schemas do not cover. No pull_request_target trigger; a workflow declares top-level permissions and never write-all; every actions/checkout step sets persist-credentials: false; a run: script never interpolates ${{ }} (values reach it through env:). Fix guide: .agent/skills/quality/ci_quality_gates_skill.md.

on.description: pull_request_target runs fork code with this repository's secrets and a write token: never used (AGENTS.md -> Boundaries).

then.description: A workflow sets the least-privilege default for every job (contents: read); jobs widen it one by one.

permissions.description: Name each permission a job needs; write-all and read-all grant everything.

run.description: A ${{ }} expression inside a script is spliced into the shell source (script injection): pass the value through env: and quote the variable.

then.description: actions/checkout must not leave the job token in .git/config, where every later step and container could read it.
